dbqa.analyzeDialog.itemConflict: The agent writes its business inferences straight into the knowledge base and marks them as inferences; it asks only about a few key ambiguities or conflicts with existing documents.
dbqa.analyzeDialog.itemFiles: Rewrites index.md plus tables/<schema.table>/business.md and schema.md for every table; existing documents are replaced whole.
dbqa.analyzeDialog.itemSwitch: The session uses this datasource automatically; you can still switch it from the session header.
dbqa.analyzeDialog.itemOverwrite: Manual edits may be overwritten; edits made outside DSH take effect on the next read.
dbqa.analyzeDialog.itemScan: Read every table's structure (DDL, indexes, foreign keys) plus a few sample rows; the connection is read-only and results are capped.
dbqa.analyzeDialog.lead: The analysis agent scans this database in a new session and writes the result as Markdown. Review what will change before you continue.
dbqa.analyzeDialog.note: You can close the session to stop the analysis. Files already written stay written; the run does not roll back as a whole.
dbqa.analyzeDialog.title: Rebuild the knowledge base for “{name}”?
dbqa.call.timeout: This call did not finish within {seconds}s; it was aborted and the connection dropped. Narrow the request (fewer tables or simpler SQL) and retry.
dbqa.datasource.analyzeStarted: Analysis session opened. The datasource is already bound.
dbqa.datasource.emptyBody: Click “Add datasource” and fill in the connection fields. There is no DSN field: every connection detail is entered one field at a time.
dbqa.datasource.noDsn: Enter each field; full DSNs are not accepted.
dbqa.datasource.subtitle: Connections are stored in the plugin's own metadata database.
dbqa.datasource.title: Datasources
dbqa.deleteDialog.itemConfig: Removes the datasource connection and its knowledge index.
dbqa.deleteDialog.itemConversations: Saved conversations are kept, but stop being linked to this datasource and can no longer use its knowledge base.
dbqa.deleteDialog.itemFiles: Recursively deletes index.md and everything under tables/ in knowledge/<datasource id>/; this cannot be recovered.
dbqa.deleteDialog.lead: This cannot be undone. Confirm what will be removed.
dbqa.deleteDialog.note: If an analysis session is running, stop it before deleting.
dbqa.deleteDialog.title: Delete “{name}”?
dbqa.error.DBQA_ANALYSIS_RUNNING: An analysis task is already running.
dbqa.error.DBQA_CONFLICT: The name is already in use.
dbqa.error.DBQA_ENV_MISSING: The referenced environment variable is not set.
dbqa.error.DBQA_INVALID_CONFIG: The connection configuration is incomplete or invalid.
dbqa.error.DBQA_SQL_REJECTED: The read-only gate rejected the SQL.
dbqa.error.DBQA_SSH_HOSTKEY: The SSH host key does not match.
dbqa.error.DBQA_TIMEOUT: Timed out ({target}): a connection or statement did not return in time, so it was aborted and the connection dropped.
dbqa.error.DBQA_TLS_REQUIRED: The server requires encryption; enable TLS.
dbqa.field.mysql.database.hint: Optional. Leave empty to use the server default database; set it when the account can only see one schema.
dbqa.field.name: Name
dbqa.field.postgresql.host.hint: Host name or IP; a Unix socket directory such as /var/run/postgresql connects over the local socket.
dbqa.field.sqlite.filePath.hint: Enter a file path only; do not paste a DSN.
dbqa.field.sqlite.immutable.hint: immutable is only safe for read-only media or snapshots that never change.
dbqa.field.ssh.sshHostFingerprint.hint: SHA256:…; leave empty to trust on first use (TOFU).
dbqa.field.ssh.useSsh.hint: Used only for this datasource; the tunnel is opened per call and torn down afterwards.
dbqa.form.disabledByVersion: This field is not supported by the detected server version.
dbqa.form.secretHint: Enter a password directly, or env:VAR to read it from the environment at connect time. Plaintext is stored in this plugin's metadata database and shown again when editing.
dbqa.form.subtitle: Connection details stay on this machine; models query through a read-only account.
dbqa.form.testHint: Testing uses a short-lived read-only connection.
dbqa.form.typeLocked: The database type cannot be changed after saving.
dbqa.group.auth.hint: Read-only account; passwords can reference env:VAR.
dbqa.group.basic.hint: The name is only used in lists.
dbqa.group.conn.hint: Host, port and database; MySQL can also use a socket.
dbqa.group.session.hint: Timeouts, charset and other connection parameters.
dbqa.group.ssh.hint: Optional; forwards through a jump host, exclusive with a socket.
dbqa.group.tls.hint: Optional; expand the advanced options when you need certificate verification.
dbqa.home.emptyAllBody: Create a query and your questions will show up here.
dbqa.home.emptyAllBodyNoDataSource: Add a data source first, then your questions will show up here.
dbqa.home.emptyFavoriteBody: Click the star on the right of a question to save it.
dbqa.home.listHint: Pick up a recent question, or start a new query against a datasource.
dbqa.kb.emptyHint: Run structure analysis on this datasource to generate its knowledge base. You can also place Markdown files in the datasource's knowledge directory.
dbqa.kb.stateStale: Modified outside DSH (reconciled on next analysis)
dbqa.kb.title: Knowledge base
dbqa.notice.ahead: The metadata database is newer than this plugin; it is opened read-only. Upgrade the plugin.
dbqa.notice.initialized: A fresh metadata database was created.
dbqa.notice.rebuilt: The metadata schema was incompatible; the old file was moved aside and a fresh database was created.
dbqa.panel.subtitle: Ask questions over your connected datasources.
dbqa.panel.title: Data Q&A
dbqa.probe.timeout: The connection test did not return within {seconds}s; it was aborted and the connection dropped. Check the host, port, network and any proxy.
dbqa.query.noSession: No datasource is selected yet: choose one in the dropdown above the input box.
dbqa.query.rejected.empty: There is no SQL to execute.
dbqa.query.rejected.firstKeyword: The read-only gate only accepts queries; received {keyword}.
dbqa.query.rejected.multiStatement: Only one statement per call is allowed; remove extra semicolons and statements.
dbqa.query.rejected.pragma: PRAGMA {keyword} is not allowed; read-only whitelist: {allowed}.
dbqa.query.rejected.writeKeyword: The read-only gate rejected the write keyword {keyword}; the query agent may only read data.
dbqa.query.timeout: The query did not return within {seconds}s; it was cancelled and the connection closed. Narrow it or aggregate.
dbqa.query.truncatedNote: The result was capped at {limit} rows (truncated=true); say so in the answer and aggregate or narrow the query.
dbqa.validation.attachmentField: Each attachment needs both an alias and a file path.
dbqa.validation.enum: Choose one of the listed values.
dbqa.validation.pair: Client certificate and key must be filled together.
dbqa.validation.port: Port must be an integer between 1 and 65535.
dbqa.validation.secret: Use env:VAR, or enter the value directly.
dbqa.validation.sshSocket: A Socket connection cannot use an SSH jump host.
dbqa.validation.sslNegotiation: direct negotiation requires sslmode=require without certificate verification.
dbqa.validation.tlsCa: This TLS mode requires a CA file.
dbqa.validation.tlsRootCert: This TLS mode requires a root certificate.
dbqa.validation.typeImmutable: The database type cannot be changed.
